title: Lazy Tart
description: A simple tart recipe with a twist. Perfect for a quick snack or dessert.
instructions: 2. Roll out the pre-made tart crust and place on a baking sheet.
3. In a bowl, whisk together the sugar, eggs, and melted butter.
4. Pour the sugar mixture into the tart crust.
5. Bake for 25-30 minutes or until the filling is set.
6. While the tart is baking, prepare the lazy sauce by mixing ketchup and a splash of water.
7. Remove the tart from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes.
8. Drizzle the lazy sauce over the top of the tart.
